visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a thick stack of white postcards placed on a dark grey graphics tablet. In the background, a row of colorful anime-style acrylic standees is arranged neatly behind the cards, with a mechanical keyboard partially visible at the top. Two text blocks in white appear at the top left and bottom center. A pair of hands enters the frame, resting on the edges of the top card. (2) The hands begin a repetitive rhythmic motion, flipping the top card over to reveal the one beneath. Each card contains unique handwritten messages in black or blue ink, accompanied by various drawings ranging from simple doodles to detailed sketches of characters. The lighting is consistent and bright, illuminating the texture of the paper and the ink strokes. (3) The flipping continues at a steady pace. The environment remains static, focusing entirely on the cards. Some cards feature small colorful stickers or logos in the corner. The background standees provide a colorful, out-of-focus backdrop. (4) Toward the end of the sequence, the person's right hand gives a thumbs-up gesture over the final card, which features a detailed drawing and a long message. The camera angle remains fixed throughout, emphasizing the content of the cards and the act of reading through them.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The person's hands are visible, wearing no accessories, flipping through a large stack of paper cards.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A dark grey graphics tablet serves as the surface for the cards. Behind it sits a black mechanical keyboard with RGB lighting and a collection of anime-themed acrylic standees.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-tempo, upbeat electronic pop track characterized by a bright synth melody and a driving rhythmic beat. Occasional paper rustling sounds occur as cards are flipped. (2) A subtle acoustic thud is heard as a new card hits the tablet surface. The music remains consistent in energy. (3) The BGM transitions seamlessly into a slightly more melodic section with airy female vocalizations in the background. (4) Towards the final third of the video, the upbeat electronic music is replaced by a gentle, sentimental solo piano piece. The tempo slows significantly. The rustling sounds become more infrequent and pronounced against the quieter musical background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The creator is showcasing and expressing deep gratitude for the large volume of handwritten letters, drawings, and postcards received from fans during the 'Illustration Taipei' event. The video serves as a heartwarming acknowledgment of fan support.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a rapid-fire montage style to show the sheer volume of fan interaction, transitioning to a softer tone at the end to emphasize sincerity.
